certified_invariants: The complete Health recovery-acknowledgement history is represented by an append-only per-entity chain with canonical ack_seq, previous_ack_hash and ack_hash.
The current recovery_ack_head is part of the hash-protected HealthControlState fingerprint, anchoring the ACK chain to authoritative durable state.
Health state reads, automatic assessments and recovery acknowledgements verify the complete ACK chain before proceeding.
ACK row deletion, payload mutation, sequence gap/reordering, previous-hash mismatch and state-head mismatch fail closed.
A recovery acknowledgement that leaves severity HEALTHY still versions durable evidence and advances the ACK-chain head, preventing a no-op ACK from disappearing without trace.
Existing pre-chain Health state with durable rows and legacy recovery acknowledgements is not silently migrated; explicit migration/rebaseline is required.
The ACK-chain hardening preserves retry-safe recovery_id semantics and does not grant execution authority.
explicit_non_claims: This is not R4 track certification.
Hash-chain tamper evidence is not a cryptographic secret or authorization credential.
This does not grant external PAPER or LIVE authority.
